holder.group: shared by the group — party, gang
holder.desk: shared at the table — one per room

list.title: Tables
list.emptyHint: Reference tables, progression by level, choice lists — all of these are tables.

card.deleteTitle: delete the table from the system
card.ownerHint: Reference table — one set of values for everyone; sheet, group or table — each has its own.
card.folderHint: Tables with the same folder are listed together.
card.noteHint: Visible only here, not shown to players.
card.rekeyRange: Ranges are a different kind of rows: the old rows will be erased.
card.rekeyWords: Words and numbers are a different kind of rows: the old rows will be erased.

column.fromNothing: nothing to choose from until a table is set
column.noTables: nothing to choose from: first create a table with rows — "{{tab}}" → "Tables"
column.formulaPlaceholder: none — the value is typed in
column.hintNote: shown next to the label on the sheet
column.requiredYes: yes — a record without it is incomplete
column.boundHint: distance band in the table: "from" and "to" in combat-grid cell units

whose.columnFormula: column of table "{{name}}" · one formula for all rows
whose.columnHolder: column of table "{{name}}" · in each row {{holder}}
whose.columnOwn: column of table "{{name}}" · each row has its own value

rows.title: Rows
rows.label: label
rows.ownSub: own for the row · shared — by click
rows.ownTitle: the column has a shared value; a row can override it: an empty cell is like the column
rows.ownHide: hide "in a new sheet" and row limits
rows.ownShow: more: "in a new sheet" and row limits

cell.clear: empty — the cell will be cleared
cell.inherited: {{formula}} — the column formula for this row; click to type the row's own

row.usedByMore: the row is used by: {{list}} and {{n}} more

tag.title: Tags
tag.sub: An action tag, for example "attack": triggers listen to "everything with the tag", roll edits edit "by tag". Tag contract — what every action with it must have.
tag.rollsNote: Roll tags are table rows; they are created in "Tables".
tag.has: What an action with this tag has
tag.hasHint: Inputs that every effect with this tag must declare: a trigger on the tag can rely on them.
tag.moreSummary: loop, results, roll traits, what it includes
tag.each: Name of each one in the loop
tag.eachHint: If the action goes over targets: "for each" must call each one by this name.
tag.outputsHint: Results every effect with this tag must give: a subscription to the tag reads them by name — “hit”.
tag.includesHint: Tags whose contract is part of this one: "melee" includes "attack".
tag.traitsHint: what can be said about the roll: a plain tag or "one of the table rows"
